profile.name: APGI-Explorer
profile.status: Draft: owner and approver sign-off pending

PRO-001.gap: Explorer implements no Protocol v1.2 definition. It consumes a pinned apgi-api contract; the Protocol v1.2 to Explorer map needs the approved definitions.

PRO-002.gap: Pinned research contract and bank hash are verified before use; no Protocol definition loader exists to test.

PRO-003.gap: Marked a dash for A07. Outbox idempotency is covered under DAT/INT.

PRO-004.gap: Profile added in this change. Owner and approver sign-off are still pending.

SCI-001.gap: APGIScorer is an instrument scoring key, not an equation implementation. Parent matrix copy (S1-CMP-01.4) is external.

SCI-002.gap: Explorer implements no dynamic threshold equation. Exclusion needs owner approval in the profile.

SCI-003.gap: No timescale hierarchy implemented. Exclusion needs owner approval.

SCI-004.gap: Display labels are descriptive and policy-checked. The controlled Notation Appendix is external; symbol-to-notation map not yet verified.

SCI-005.gap: Scoring constants (1-4 responses, 12.5-87.5 display scale) are documented in code. No provenance label registry (derived/calibrated/assumed) exists.

SCI-006.gap: Canonical name enforced by the language policy gate. Archive and remote metadata not verified.

SCI-007.gap: User-visible text is label-policed and framed as exploratory. No CLM-nnn claim register or statement-to-claim map yet; that register is external.

REP-001.gap: Instrument bank and contract artifacts are SHA-256 pinned and CI-verified. Protocol lock and OpenTimestamps proof are external.

REP-002.gap: Scorer is deterministic with no randomness. Shared Swift/Python vectors are reproducible. Cross-platform numerical comparison is limited to the portable Linux job.

REP-003.gap: Marked a dash for A07. Explorer performs no power or sample-size calculation.

REP-004.gap: Marked a dash for A07. Personal snapshots carry analysis_mode=exploratory.

IMP-001.gap: Source commit and contract hashes are pinned. No release-bound build record, artifact digests or SBOM for a candidate.

IMP-002.gap: Secret scan, Keychain storage and sandbox entitlement verification exist. Production-credential review against deployed auth is pending.

IMP-003.gap: Crash reporting exists. No fault-injection evidence that operational alerts and handoff work.

DAT-001.gap: Scorer rejects incomplete, unknown-ID and out-of-range input. Golden dataset approval by the scientific authority is pending.

DAT-002.gap: Marked a dash for A07. Outbox duplicate and lost-ack handling is tested anyway.

DAT-003.gap: Local deletion and export exist. No approved per-data-class retention and recovery rules.

DAT-004.gap: Instrument bank is versioned, checksummed and bound to every research event. License and full processing history are not recorded in results.

API-001.gap: Generated catalogs are checked against the pinned OpenAPI snapshot and the apgi-api commit. Deployed consumer-contract evidence is pending.

API-002.gap: Device-local credentials and refresh rotation exist. Live authorization review pending; research disabled.

API-003.gap: Tokens live in Keychain, the transport rejects non-HTTPS origins, secret scan in CI. At-rest encryption of local session data is not separately evidenced.

API-004.gap: Errors are surfaced as named states. Redaction of server excerpts needs a test.

INT-001.gap: Sealed research contract is hash-pinned to apgi-api and shared vectors match. Protocol-version field requirement awaits the canonical schemas.

INT-002.gap: Needs a pinned release set across all components. Only an in-memory API simulation exists.

INT-003.gap: Scorer returns explicit errors; research scores outside the allow-list are rejected. No substitute values.

INT-004.gap: Displayed values come from the scorer or the allow-listed server score. Retained comparison at displayed precision against upstream artifacts is pending.

REL-001.gap: CI definitions exist. Branch protection is not enforced and no approved immutable candidate record exists.

REL-002.gap: Install and build steps exist. No candidate-specific rollback record.

REL-003.gap: Audit and CI exist. No per-change validation-impact assessment trail.

REL-004.gap: App 1.0, bank 1.0.0 and pinned contract are recorded. Compatibility with Protocol v1.2 is not claimed or tested.

REL-005.gap: No release certificate or archival deposit plan. Certificate-before-deposit rule needs an owner and process.

CON-001.gap: Four-purpose versioned consent validation blocks enrolment and upload. Consent texts are drafts and research is disabled pending S1-PRV-06 approval.

CON-002.gap: Local copy is deleted only after server_verified acknowledgement. Server-side withdrawal orchestration and backup policy are external.

VAL-001.gap: Explorer makes no registered validation decision.

CLI-001.gap: Reference scoring, privacy manifest and accessibility support exist. The declared accessibility level is [CONFIRM] and no accessibility report is retained.
